Yeastar Announces Yeahs Awards 2026 Winners Highlighting AI and Partner Innovations

30 Oct 2026, 08:25 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.prnewswire.com

Yeastar, a global provider of Unified Communications (UC) solutions, has officially announced the winners of its Yeahs Awards 2026. The annual program recognizes international channel partners for achievements in business growth, technical innovation, and customer success, with a strong emphasis on artificial intelligence integration and API-driven automation.

According to the announcement, the recognized projects span multiple continents and demonstrate how open UC platforms can optimize customer service, streamline migrations, and automate routine business communications.

Global Partner Achievements and AI Integration

The 2026 awards highlighted several key implementations executed by global partners:

  • Rezzo Telecom (France): Multiplied its cloud presence eightfold after migrating from Vodia to Yeastar, simplifying UCaaS operations and expanding service offerings.
  • Vela Networks (United Kingdom): Developed tools that reduce UC migration time from days to minutes by automating data mapping and configuration transfers across four platforms.
  • Telex S.r.l. (Italy): Combined voice, messaging, workflows, and AI through its 'Konversa' solution, utilizing models from Gemini and OpenAI to automate up to 70% of first-tier queries.
  • Comunic.se (Brazil): Unified multisite communications for Fontline using P-Series Cloud, featuring a multilingual AI receptionist and automated transcription to lower manual call management.
  • Dialerportal (United States): Recorded a 91% reduction in quality assurance effort and increased problematic call detection from 63% to 98% during a pilot at Prime BPO & Telecommunications.
  • CMIT Systemhaus (Germany): Migrated KNOP NEUSTADT GMBH from Unify to the P-Series software edition, adding Linkus and a locally hosted AI transcription service.
  • The VoIP Shop (United Kingdom): Integrated the P-Series, Microsoft Teams presence, and SIMS at The Mountbatten School, generating an estimated annual staff time savings of over 97 hours.
  • Alliance-com (France) and CommsPlus Distribution (Australia): Named Solution Distributor Champions 2026 for supporting partner success through complex deployments, cloud growth, and API automation.

"The AI-enabled capabilities and open platforms of Yeastar allow our partners to innovate beyond traditional communications," said Arya Zhou, Global Sales Director at Yeastar, in the official statement.

Practical Implications and Context

For businesses utilizing unified communications, the recognized projects illustrate the practical scaling potential of combining cloud telephony with open APIs and artificial intelligence. Companies evaluating similar upgrades can observe how automated data mapping, AI-driven transcription, and integrated messaging workflows translate into measurable reductions in administrative workloads and quality assurance efforts.

Readers should note that the results highlighted in the awards represent specific, high-performing partner deployments selected by the vendor rather than universal benchmarks. Performance outcomes will vary depending on existing infrastructure, implementation scope, and configuration complexity.

Verified Facts vs. Unknowns

  • Confirmed: Yeastar announced the Yeahs Awards 2026 winners on October 29, 2026, from Xiamen, China. The awards acknowledge specific companies in France, the UK, Italy, Brazil, the US, Germany, and Australia for achievements in cloud migration, AI automation, and UC deployment efficiency.
  • Unknown: Specific financial terms, long-term contractual commitments, or exact deployment costs for the referenced projects were not disclosed in the company announcement.

Readers interested in verifying the original announcement, reviewing company background, or exploring technical specifications can consult the official source details on the [Yeastar News Release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/yeastar-reconoce-la-ia-la-innovacion-tecnica-y-el-exito-de-los-clientes-en-los-yeahs-awards-2026-302917649.html) or visit [Yeastar's official website](https://www.yeastar.com).
